03 / EXCITATION

From input spectrum to response.

Educational broadband PSD — NOT a DO-160 or MIL-STD-810 qualification profile

Source: User-defined illustrative breakpoints; replace with a documented project requirement.

0.0082mmProbe relative displacement · 3σ
90.26%Directional modal mass / solver total
2.50%Assumed modal damping
20.0Resonant amplification factor

Captured mass is 90.0% of full CAD mass; the solver denominator excludes constrained degrees of freedom. The input is interpolated as power laws between breakpoints and set to zero outside the specified band. Adaptive quadrature resolves each resonance. The response is linear and truncated to the extracted modes; amplitude accuracy requires damping and mode-count studies.

06 / TRACEABILITY

Keep the assumptions with the result.

Interpretation & limits

  • Simulation only. No physical qualification or compliance is demonstrated.
  • Linear elastic model; mounting patches idealize perfectly clamped connections.
  • Probe response uses a truncated, coherent modal sum for one base-input axis.
  • Input PSD is illustrative unless replaced with a documented requirement.
  • PCB result is an independent plate estimate with direct base PSD; it is not an enclosure-coupled fatigue-life prediction.
